home.title: Home
home.intro: This is your start page once you're signed in. Everything the app can do is one search away.

tips.palette: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows and Linux) to jump to any page, find a person, or change a setting without leaving the keyboard.
tips.admin: Admins manage everyone's accounts from the Users page.
tips.preferences: Your avatar menu (top right) switches language, toggles dark mode and signs you out.

admin.title: Users
admin.intro: Everyone with an account is listed here. Search, sort and page through them; changes apply immediately.

tips.search: Search matches names and email addresses. Results come from the server, so they cover every user, not just this page.
tips.sort: Click the Name or Joined column header to sort; click again to reverse it.
tips.admin: The switch on each row grants or removes admin access. You can't change or delete your own account here.
tips.delete: Deleting a user is permanent: their sessions and data are removed.
tips.share: The page, search and sort are part of the address, so you can bookmark a view or send it to someone.

login.title: Signing in
login.intro: There's no password to remember: you sign in with your email.

tips.code: Enter your email and we'll send a 6-digit code. Type it here to sign in.
tips.link: The email also contains a sign-in link — opening it on this device signs you in directly.
tips.missing: No email after a minute? Check your spam folder, then request a new code.
